Methodology: the field is every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for West Palm Beach dance searches on 29 Oct 2026. The South Florida coast is split into three pages: Miami (Miami-Dade), Fort Lauderdale (Broward) and Boca Raton (south Palm Beach County), with West Palm Beach covering the north of Palm Beach County. The studio Google lists simply as "Ballroom Dance Studio" on Palm Beach Lakes Boulevard is Grigol Kranz's studio; Google's AI Mode and ChatGPT call it Ballroom Dance Studio (iBallroomdance). Gemini named Ballroom Luxe Dance Studio, which didn't appear in Google's local results for these searches. Each studio's site was crawled and graded across seven categories (AI readiness, SEO basics, page structure, content depth, social, image alt text, technical) on the same day. Google local positions come from four searches (ballroom dance lessons west palm beach fl, dance lessons west palm beach fl, salsa lessons west palm beach fl and wedding dance lessons west palm beach fl). AI visibility reflects live sessions in the public ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI apps, asked the two queries shown above; presence was confirmed by reading each engine's raw answer directly. This is an independent measurement by Ballroom Dance Directory, not commissioned by any studio named above. Rankings reflect a point-in-time snapshot and will be re-run periodically. The complete scorecard, Google table and AI answers are in the detailed report.

In West Palm Beach, 18 studios compete for dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 18 dance and ballroom studios serving the West Palm Beach market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 45 to 83. The AI engines name only seven of the 18. The field averages 60 (D) on AI readiness, 18 of 18 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 14 of 18 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 29 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the West Palm Beach, FL area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 18 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Fred Astaire Dance Studios Wellington (83) and Starpoint Dancesport (82) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 45. Three scores are shared.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 60 (D) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 85.
  • None of the 18 studios has FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 14 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. No studio in the market has both.
  • Four of the 18 are franchise locations (four Fred Astaire); the rest are independent studios.
  • The gap between #1 and #18 is 38 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

For a studio not doing this work, that's the default outcome — not a penalty, just the result of nobody in that seat having claimed it yet.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in West Palm Beach.” Studios that serve West Palm Beach from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

Methodology & notes

Field (18 studios): fredastaire.com/wellington, starpointdancesport.com, palmbeachdancing.com, fredastaire.com/jupiter, fredastaire.com/palm-beach-gardens, dancehubpalmbeach.com, dancelessonspalmbeach.com, fredastaire.com/west-palm-beach, rhythmswpb.com, ambiancedancestudio.com, legacydancesport.com, dancecrush.com, inmotionballroom.com, sultryswing.com, grigolkranz.com, sandracruz.us, danceallnightballroom.com, avdanceacademy.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 29 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for West Palm Beach dance searches. The South Florida coast is split into three pages: Miami (Miami-Dade), Fort Lauderdale (Broward) and Boca Raton (south Palm Beach County), with West Palm Beach covering the north of Palm Beach County. The studio Google lists simply as "Ballroom Dance Studio" on Palm Beach Lakes Boulevard is Grigol Kranz's studio; Google's AI Mode and ChatGPT call it Ballroom Dance Studio (iBallroomdance). Gemini named Ballroom Luxe Dance Studio, which didn't appear in Google's local results for these searches. Left out: Gala Ballroom (no studio address on Google), DancewithJulie (its domain is parked), and the youth, ballet and hip-hop studios that lead the broad answers (Industry Dance, Ballet East, Soul Movement, Robin Cotler Dance Center).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 29 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories. Franchise locations that live on a national website (Fred Astaire) share that site's robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap and templates.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in West Palm Beach, FL?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in West Palm Beach, FL?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's web app (ChatGPT and Gemini logged out, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 29 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons west palm beach fl”; “dance lessons west palm beach fl”; “salsa lessons west palm beach fl”; “wedding dance lessons west palm beach fl”; “ballroom dance lessons palm beach gardens fl”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in west palm beach fl” and “ballroom dance studio west palm beach”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
